issues.description: The text '34 DECK O BARROW' in the top right corner has a '0' where a '0' (zero) is expected, but it appears to be a capital 'O' instead, which is a garbled glyph.
The text 'ROOT WA' on the last card in the player's hand is clipped, indicating it spills outside the card boundary or is not fully rendered.
The map element in the top right corner has a question mark icon rendered on top of what appears to be a card slot, making the underlying UI element unclear.
The text 'Dig Ch:' under 'Rewards' is cut off and incomplete. It should likely be 'Dig Chance' or similar.
The text '34 DECK O BARROW' in the top right corner has a '0' where a letter 'OF' or similar is expected, making it look like a placeholder or garbled text.
The text 'DUSKEANG' is likely a typo and should be 'DUSKFANG'.
The text 'THE WAYFARER | 25' and '34 DECK O BARROW' in the top right corner are rendered with extremely low contrast against the dark background, making them very difficult to read.
The text 'TRIKZOS | 0' in the bottom left corner is rendered with low contrast against its green background, making it somewhat difficult to read.
The text 'SWORD' and 'DUSKEANG' in the bottom left corner are rendered with low contrast against their dark background, making them somewhat difficult to read.
The text 'Turns taken: 1' is rendered with low contrast against the dark background of the defeat panel, making it somewhat difficult to read.  [and 1 more like it]
The text 'Shards +15', 'Dig Charges +2', and 'Fragments +EMBER:1' are rendered with low contrast against the dark background of the defeat panel, making them somewhat difficult to read.
The text 'VERDANTMB' is clipped and overlaps with the 'ALL' filter button, making it difficult to read. It appears to be a partial rendering of 'VERDANT' and 'EMBER' or similar.
The text 'HOL' is clipped and overlaps with the 'TIDE' filter button, making it difficult to read. It appears to be a partial rendering of 'HOLY' or similar.
The 'NEW' badge on the 'WILDFIRE ADEPT' card is partially obscured by the card's border, making it look misaligned.
The text 'VERD' in the filter options is partially obscured by the 'ALL' filter, making it difficult to read.  [and 4 more like it]
The 'New' badge on the 'SUNBLADE RECRUIT' card is rendered on top of the card's border, causing a visual overlap.  [and 2 more like it]
The scrollbar on the right side of the screen is very thin and difficult to see, potentially impacting usability.
The 'Owned 13 / 146' and 'Runes: 0' text in the top right corner has low contrast against the dark background, making it somewhat difficult to read.
The text 'Diag' in the top-left corner is rendered on top of the background art without any container, making it appear as a debug overlay that should not be visible to players.
The text 'Region 1' and 'Cards: 0' under 'Warrior' have very low contrast against their dark background, making them difficult to read.
The 'Delete' button text is partially obscured by the 'Continue' button's background, making it look misaligned and unprofessional.
The text 'SEX' is present as a UI label, which is likely a placeholder or an error, as 'SFX' (Sound Effects) is the common term in game settings.
The text '80' next to the 'Music' slider is very low contrast against the dark background, making it hard to read.  [and 1 more like it]
The text '100' next to the 'SFX' (labeled 'SEX') slider is very low contrast against the dark background, making it hard to read.
The text 'Low' next to 'Graphics Quality' is very low contrast against the dark background, making it hard to read.
The text '0.1.0 (20bdfbf9)' in the bottom right corner is extremely low contrast against the dark background, making it almost illegible.
The scrollbar on the right side of the screen is present but there is no content to scroll, suggesting a layout issue or an unnecessary UI element.
The overall layout is severely unbalanced, with a large empty space on the right side of the screen while all interactive elements are crammed into the left, making it look unfinished.
